able.example_en: She is able to finish the science report without any help.
able.example_zh: 她能够独自完成那份科学报告。

abnormal.example_en: A temperature of forty degrees is abnormal and needs a doctor.
abnormal.example_zh: 四十度的体温不正常，需要去看医生。

absolute.example_en: The hall stayed in absolute silence while the exam began.
absolute.example_zh: 考试开始时，大厅里保持着绝对的安静。

acceptable.example_en: Handing in the essay one day late was acceptable this time.
acceptable.example_zh: 这次作文晚交一天是可以接受的。

accessible.example_en: The new ramp makes the library accessible to wheelchair users.
accessible.example_zh: 新坡道让坐轮椅的人也能进入图书馆。

accidental.example_en: An accidental bump knocked the paint onto his white shirt.
accidental.example_zh: 一次意外的碰撞把颜料弄到了他的白衬衫上。

active.example_en: She takes an active part in the class debate.

actual.example_en: The actual number of visitors was twice what we guessed.
actual.example_zh: 实际的参观人数是我们估计的两倍。

additional.example_en: Mum packed additional snacks because the hike would be long.
additional.example_zh: 因为徒步路程很长，妈妈额外装了些零食。

adorable.example_en: Everyone smiled at the adorable baby in the red hat.
adorable.example_zh: 大家看见戴红帽子的可爱宝宝都笑了。

advanced.example_en: Only advanced students may enter the chemistry lab alone.
advanced.example_zh: 只有高级班的学生可以独自进入化学实验室。

adverbial.example_en: An adverbial phrase at the start tells when the action happened.
adverbial.example_zh: 句首的状语短语说明动作是什么时候发生的。

aged.example_en: The aged man walks his dog around the lake at dusk.
aged.example_zh: 那位年老的男士黄昏时绕着湖遛狗。

aggressive.example_en: The history book described an aggressive attack on the island.
aggressive.example_zh: 历史书描述了对那座岛的侵略性进攻。

agricultural.example_en: We visited an agricultural show and saw cows that won prizes.
agricultural.example_zh: 我们参观了农业展览，看到了获奖的牛。

alcoholic.example_en: Alcoholic drinks were banned at the school leavers' party.
alcoholic.example_zh: 学校毕业生聚会上禁止含酒精的饮料。

alive.example_en: Luckily the goldfish was still alive after the weekend.
alive.example_zh: 幸运的是，那条金鱼过完周末还活着。

allergic.example_en: Ben is allergic to cats, so he sneezes at his aunt's flat.
allergic.example_zh: 本对猫过敏，所以在阿姨家会打喷嚏。

alright.example_en: Dad said it was alright to borrow his umbrella today.
alright.example_zh: 爸爸说今天可以借他的伞。

amazed.example_en: I was amazed when the quiet boy won the singing prize.
amazed.example_zh: 那个安静的男孩赢得歌唱奖时，我非常吃惊。

ambitious.example_en: The ambitious student aims for the top score in physics.
ambitious.example_zh: 那个有野心的学生想拿下物理最高分。

American.example_en: Our host family cooked an American breakfast with pancakes.
American.example_zh: 寄宿家庭给我们做了有煎饼的美式早餐。

amused.example_en: The toddlers were amused by the puppet show in the hall.
amused.example_zh: 大厅里的木偶戏把幼儿们逗乐了。

amusing.example_en: Grandpa told an amusing joke while we washed the dishes.
amusing.example_zh: 我们洗碗时，爷爷讲了一个有趣的笑话。

animated.example_en: The children loved the animated film about a lost robot.
animated.example_zh: 孩子们喜欢那部关于迷路机器人的动画电影。

annoying.example_en: That annoying drip from the tap kept me up all night.
annoying.example_zh: 水龙头恼人的滴水声让我整夜没睡着。

annual.example_en: Our annual school fair raises money for new library books.
annual.example_zh: 我们一年一度的学校义卖为图书馆的新书筹款。

anti.example_en: Her history essay was anti-war and earned a high mark.
anti.example_zh: 她的历史作文反对战争，并且得了高分。

armed.example_en: Armed officers checked bags at the stadium entrance.
armed.example_zh: 武装人员在体育场入口检查了背包。

artificial.example_en: These artificial flowers do not need water or sunlight.
artificial.example_zh: 这些人造花不需要水和阳光。

artistic.example_en: Her artistic design for the poster won the class vote.
artistic.example_zh: 她为海报做的艺术设计赢得了全班投票。

ashamed.example_en: He felt ashamed after copying answers during the quiz.
ashamed.example_zh: 他在测验中抄了答案，事后感到羞愧。

Asian.example_en: We ordered Asian noodles at the small restaurant downtown.
Asian.example_zh: 我们在市中心的小餐馆点了亚洲面条。

asleep.example_en: The baby was asleep in the pram during the whole walk.
asleep.example_zh: 整个散步途中，宝宝都在婴儿车里睡着。

assistant.example_en: The assistant coach timed every lap on the running track.
assistant.example_zh: 助理教练在跑道上给每一圈计时。

athletic.example_en: My athletic brother plays both football and basketball.
athletic.example_zh: 我那健壮的哥哥既踢足球又打篮球。

atomic.example_en: The textbook diagram shows atomic structure in simple steps.
atomic.example_zh: 课本上的图用简单步骤展示原子结构。

attractive.example_en: Bright colours made the poster attractive from across the hall.
attractive.example_zh: 鲜艳的颜色让海报在大厅另一头也很吸引人。

audio.example_en: The audio guide described each painting in the museum.
audio.example_zh: 音频导览介绍了博物馆里的每一幅画。

Australian.example_en: My Australian pen friend sent photos of a beach near Sydney.
Australian.example_zh: 我的澳大利亚笔友寄来了悉尼附近海滩的照片。

automatic.example_en: The automatic doors opened as we entered the supermarket.
automatic.example_zh: 我们走进超市时，自动门打开了。

auxiliary.example_en: An auxiliary generator kept the lights on during the storm.
auxiliary.example_zh: 暴风雨期间，辅助发电机让灯一直亮着。

available.example_en: Seats are still available for the concert in the school hall.
available.example_zh: 学校礼堂的音乐会还有空位。

average.example_en: His average mark in English rose from sixty to seventy-five.
average.example_zh: 他的英语平均分从六十分升到了七十五分。

awake.example_en: I stayed awake until I heard Mum's key in the door.
awake.example_zh: 我一直醒着，直到听见妈妈用钥匙开门。

aware.example_en: She became aware of the smoke and called for a teacher.
aware.example_zh: 她察觉到烟味，立刻叫来了老师。

awesome.example_en: The view from the cable car was awesome in clear weather.
awesome.example_zh: 天气晴朗时，从缆车看出去的景色棒极了。

awful.example_en: An awful smell came from the unlocked fridge this morning.
awful.example_zh: 今天早上，没关严的冰箱里冒出一股可怕的气味。

awkward.example_en: His awkward hands dropped the cups while he washed up.
awkward.example_zh: 他笨拙的双手在洗碗时把杯子掉了。

bad.example_en: The bad apple at the bottom spoiled the rest of the fruit.
bad.example_zh: 底部的坏苹果把其余的水果也弄坏了。

bald.example_en: My bald grandfather wears a cap when he works in the garden.
bald.example_zh: 我秃头的爷爷在花园干活时会戴帽子。

bare.example_en: The children ran across the hot sand with bare feet.
bare.example_zh: 孩子们光着脚跑过滚烫的沙子。

basic.example_en: Cooks learn basic knife skills before they cut vegetables.
basic.example_zh: 厨师在切菜之前先学基本的用刀技巧。

beautiful.example_en: The beautiful bridge looks golden when the sun sets.
beautiful.example_zh: 日落时，那座美丽的桥看上去金灿灿的。

beloved.example_en: She read her beloved diary again on the train home.
beloved.example_zh: 她在回家的火车上又读了一遍心爱的日记。

bent.example_en: The bent wheel made his bicycle wobble on the way home.
bent.example_zh: 弯曲的车轮让他的自行车在回家路上一直晃。

best.example_en: She saved her best painting for the campus art show.
best.example_zh: 她把最好的画留到校园画展上展出。

better.example_en: This pencil is better for sketching than the cheap one.
better.example_zh: 这支铅笔比那支便宜的更适合素描。

big.example_en: A big dog waited outside the bakery for its owner.
big.example_zh: 一只大狗在面包店外面等它的主人。

bilingual.example_en: The bilingual menu lists dishes in both Chinese and English.
bilingual.example_zh: 双语菜单用中文和英文列出菜品。

bitter.example_en: The bitter medicine worked, though he hated the taste.
bitter.example_zh: 这种苦药起了作用，尽管他讨厌那个味道。

black.example_en: A black umbrella kept both of us dry in the storm.
black.example_zh: 一把黑伞让我们俩在暴风雨里没被淋湿。

blank.example_en: Write your name on the blank line at the top of the page.
blank.example_zh: 把你的名字写在页面上方的空白线上。

blind.example_en: The blind passenger asked where the next stop was.
blind.example_zh: 那位失明的乘客问下一站在哪里。

blonde.example_en: The blonde singer waved to her family in the front row.
blonde.example_zh: 那位金发歌手向第一排的家人挥了挥手。

blue.example_en: Her blue scarf blew off while she waited for the bus.
blue.example_zh: 她等公交时，蓝围巾被风吹走了。

boiled.example_en: Boiled potatoes and carrots were all we had for dinner.
boiled.example_zh: 晚饭我们只有煮土豆和胡萝卜。

bold.example_en: Her bold colours made the classroom mural easy to notice.
bold.example_zh: 她大胆的配色让教室壁画很容易被注意到。

bored.example_en: The boys grew bored halfway through the long assembly.
bored.example_zh: 冗长的集会进行到一半，男孩们就感到无聊了。

bound.example_en: She felt bound to return the wallet she found on the bus.
bound.example_zh: 她觉得必须把在公交车上捡到的钱包还回去。

brave.example_en: A brave firefighter carried the child out of the smoke.
brave.example_zh: 一位勇敢的消防员把孩子从烟雾中抱了出来。

brief.example_en: The principal gave a brief welcome before the concert started.
brief.example_zh: 音乐会开始前，校长做了简短的欢迎。

bright.example_en: Bright lamps over the desk help my eyes during homework.
bright.example_zh: 书桌上方的明亮台灯让我写作业时眼睛更舒服。

British.example_en: British coins look different from the ones in my pocket.
British.example_zh: 英国硬币和我口袋里的那些看起来不一样。

broad.example_en: A broad path leads from the gate to the sports field.
broad.example_zh: 一条宽阔的小路从大门通向运动场。

broken.example_en: We taped the broken chair so nobody would sit on it.
broken.example_zh: 我们把坏椅子用胶带封住，免得有人去坐。

brown.example_en: Brown shoes got muddy on the way across the wet field.
brown.example_zh: 棕色的鞋子在穿过湿地时沾上了泥。

busy.example_en: The busy waiter forgot our soup during the lunch rush.
busy.example_zh: 忙碌的服务员在午饭高峰时忘了我们的汤。

Canadian.example_en: My Canadian uncle coaches ice hockey at a local rink.
Canadian.example_zh: 我的加拿大叔叔在当地溜冰场教冰球。

Catholic.example_en: They sing in a Catholic church choir on Sunday mornings.
Catholic.example_zh: 他们周日上午在天主教堂的唱诗班唱歌。

central.example_en: Our flat is central, so the ride to school is short.
central.example_zh: 我们的公寓在市中心，所以去学校的路程很短。

certain.example_en: I am certain the keys are still in my coat pocket.
certain.example_zh: 我确定钥匙还在我的外套口袋里。

cheeky.example_en: The cheeky parrot repeated our teacher's hello from its cage.
cheeky.example_zh: 那只厚脸皮的鹦鹉在笼子里重复我们老师的问候。

chief.example_en: Safety is the chief concern when we use the science lab.
chief.example_zh: 我们使用科学实验室时，安全是最主要的考虑。

Chinese.example_en: Chinese tea is served after meals at my grandparents' house.
Chinese.example_zh: 在爷爷奶奶家，饭后会上一壶中国茶。

civil.example_en: The poster listed basic civil rights beside the classroom door.
civil.example_zh: 海报在教室门边列出了基本的公民权利。

classic.example_en: This classic song still plays at our winter school dance.
classic.example_zh: 这首经典歌曲仍会在我们的冬季学校舞会上播放。

classical.example_en: She practises classical piano for an hour after supper.
classical.example_zh: 她晚饭后会练一个小时的古典钢琴。

clean.example_en: His clean shirt was ready on the bed before the interview.
clean.example_zh: 面试前，他的干净衬衫已经放在床上。

clear.example_en: Her clear explanation helped me understand the map scale.
clear.example_zh: 她清楚的讲解帮我明白了地图的比例尺。

clever.example_en: A clever shortcut through the park gets us home faster.
clever.example_zh: 穿过公园的一条巧妙近路让我们更快到家。

clinical.example_en: Students practise clinical skills at the hospital open day.
clinical.example_zh: 学生们在医院开放日练习临床技能。

comfortable.example_en: These comfortable trainers are what I wear for long walks.
comfortable.example_zh: 我走远路时就穿这双舒适的运动鞋。

common.example_en: Plastic rulers are common in nearly every pencil case.
common.example_zh: 几乎每个铅笔盒里都有塑料尺，这很常见。

competitive.example_en: The competitive final drew a huge crowd to the school gym.
competitive.example_zh: 这场竞争激烈的决赛把一大群人吸引到了学校体育馆。

comprehensive.example_en: This comprehensive guide lists every bus that passes the school.
comprehensive.example_zh: 这本全面的指南列出了经过学校的每一路公交。

confident.example_en: She sounded confident when she introduced the guest speaker.
confident.example_zh: 她介绍演讲嘉宾时，声音听起来很自信。

contemporary.example_en: Contemporary dance was the highlight of the talent show.
contemporary.example_zh: 当代舞是才艺表演中最精彩的部分。

continuous.example_en: Continuous rain flooded the path behind the science block.
continuous.example_zh: 连续的降雨淹没了科学楼后面的小路。

conventional.example_en: A conventional oven takes longer than our microwave at home.
conventional.example_zh: 家里的传统烤箱比微波炉花的时间更长。

cool.example_en: The cool shade under the oak saved us from the heat.
cool.example_zh: 橡树下凉爽的树荫让我们躲开了酷热。

correct.example_en: Check that the correct name is printed on your exam card.
correct.example_zh: 核对准考证上印的姓名是否正确。

creative.example_en: His creative use of cardboard became a model of our town.
creative.example_zh: 他有创意地用纸板做成了我们小镇的模型。

criminal.example_en: Criminal damage to the lockers was reported before lunch.
criminal.example_zh: 午饭前，有人报告储物柜被人故意破坏了。

critical.example_en: The injured player was in a critical condition that night.
critical.example_zh: 那名受伤的球员当晚伤势危急。

cultural.example_en: The cultural festival featured songs from five countries.
cultural.example_zh: 文化节上表演了来自五个国家的歌曲。

current.example_en: The current timetable is pinned on the board by the office.
current.example_zh: 当前的时刻表钉在办公室旁边的布告板上。

daft.example_en: It felt daft to wear sandals during that heavy snowstorm.
daft.example_zh: 在那场大暴风雪里穿凉鞋，感觉太蠢了。

daily.example_en: Daily practice on the violin has improved her tone.
daily.example_zh: 每天练小提琴让她的音色变好了。

dead.example_en: Dead leaves were swept into piles along the garden path.
dead.example_zh: 枯叶被扫成一堆一堆，沿着花园小径堆好。

decent.example_en: He made a decent apology and his friend accepted it.
decent.example_zh: 他得体地道了歉，朋友接受了。

deep.example_en: The pond is deep at the far end, so swimming is banned there.
deep.example_zh: 池塘远端水深，所以那里禁止游泳。

dependent.example_en: Young chicks are dependent on the hen for warmth.

detailed.example_en: She kept a detailed record of how the beans grew.
detailed.example_zh: 她详细记录了豆子的生长情况。

direct.example_en: Is there a direct train from our town to the capital?
direct.example_zh: 从我们镇到首都有直达火车吗？

dirty.example_en: Dirty boots were left outside so the kitchen floor stayed clean.
dirty.example_zh: 脏靴子放在门外，厨房地板才保持干净。

disabled.example_en: A disabled athlete finished the city race in a wheelchair.
disabled.example_zh: 一位残疾运动员坐着轮椅完成了城市赛跑。

disgusting.example_en: The disgusting mould on the bread meant we threw it away.
disgusting.example_zh: 面包上恶心的霉让我们把它扔掉了。

distinctive.example_en: His distinctive handwriting is easy to spot on shared posters.
distinctive.example_zh: 他与众不同的笔迹在共用的海报上很容易认出来。

diverse.example_en: The diverse menu offers rice, noodles, soup, and salad.
diverse.example_zh: 多样的菜单上有米饭、面条、汤和沙拉。

domestic.example_en: Domestic flights were delayed because of the thick fog.
domestic.example_zh: 国内航班因为浓雾延误了。

double.example_en: We ordered a double portion of rice after the long hike.
double.example_zh: 长途徒步之后，我们点了双份米饭。

dramatic.example_en: A dramatic sunset turned the whole lake red and purple.
dramatic.example_zh: 戏剧性的日落把整个湖染成了红色和紫色。

dry.example_en: The towels were dry after an hour in the hot sun.
dry.example_zh: 毛巾在烈日下晒了一个小时就干了。

due.example_en: The history essay is due before the winter holiday begins.
due.example_zh: 历史作文在寒假开始之前必须交。

Dutch.example_en: We tried Dutch cheese at the food stall beside the river.
Dutch.example_zh: 我们在河边的食品摊品尝了荷兰奶酪。

east.example_en: The east side of the house stays cool during hot afternoons.
east.example_zh: 房子的东侧在炎热的下午仍然凉快。

eastern.example_en: Eastern provinces expect heavy snow according to the forecast.
eastern.example_zh: 根据天气预报，东部省份将有大雪。

easy.example_en: The easy questions at the start gave everyone some confidence.
easy.example_zh: 开头的简单题目给了每个人一些信心。

economic.example_en: The economic report on the evening news worried my parents.
economic.example_zh: 晚间新闻里的经济报道让我父母担心。

educational.example_en: The educational visit to the dam taught us how power is made.
educational.example_zh: 这次有教育意义的大坝参观让我们明白了电是怎样产生的。

effective.example_en: Short, effective notes helped her revise while riding the bus.
effective.example_zh: 简短而有效的笔记帮她在坐公交时复习。

elderly.example_en: An elderly neighbour waters our plants whenever we travel.
elderly.example_zh: 我们外出时，一位年长的邻居会给植物浇水。

electric.example_en: The electric fan kept our classroom bearable in June.
electric.example_zh: 电风扇让我们的教室在六月还能待下去。

electrical.example_en: An electrical fault shut the lights off during the play.
electrical.example_zh: 一次电气故障让演出中途灯灭了。

electronic.example_en: Electronic tickets on his phone got us into the museum.
electronic.example_zh: 他手机上的电子票让我们进了博物馆。

embarrassed.example_en: She felt embarrassed when her phone rang in the quiet library.
embarrassed.example_zh: 她的手机在安静的图书馆里响了，她觉得很尴尬。

embarrassing.example_en: Tripping on the stage was embarrassing, but she kept singing.
embarrassing.example_zh: 在台上绊倒很尴尬，但她继续唱了下去。

emotional.example_en: The emotional song made several parents cry at the concert.
emotional.example_zh: 那首伤感的歌让好几位家长在音乐会上哭了。

empty.example_en: The empty bottle rolled under the seat during the bus ride.
empty.example_zh: 空瓶子在乘公交时滚到了座位底下。

environmental.example_en: Our environmental club cleaned rubbish from the riverbank.
environmental.example_zh: 我们的环境社团清理了河岸上的垃圾。

equal.example_en: Both teams had equal numbers of players after the change.
equal.example_zh: 调整之后，两队的球员人数相等。

equivalent.example_en: A kilometre is equivalent to one thousand metres.

European.example_en: European cities appear often in our geography worksheets this term.
European.example_zh: 欧洲城市经常出现在我们这学期的地理练习里。

everyday.example_en: Everyday shoes are fine for the walk, so leave the heavy boots.
everyday.example_zh: 这次走路穿日常的鞋就行，把沉重的靴子留下。

exact.example_en: Measure the exact length of the table before buying the cloth.
exact.example_zh: 买桌布之前，先量一量桌子的准确长度。

excellent.example_en: Her excellent drawing hung in the school corridor all month.
excellent.example_zh: 她的优秀画作在学校走廊里挂了整整一个月。

excited.example_en: The pupils were excited about visiting the zoo on Thursday.
excited.example_zh: 学生们对周四去动物园感到兴奋。

exclusive.example_en: Membership at that exclusive club costs more than my bicycle.
exclusive.example_zh: 那个排外俱乐部的会费比我的自行车还贵。

existing.example_en: The existing bridge stays open while workers build the new one.
existing.example_zh: 工人修建新桥时，现有的桥仍然开放。

experienced.example_en: An experienced guide led us safely along the cliff path.
experienced.example_zh: 一位有经验的向导带领我们安全地走过悬崖小道。

extended.example_en: The extended lunch break let us finish eating without rushing.
extended.example_zh: 延长的午休让我们从容吃完了饭。

extensive.example_en: Extensive damage followed the storm that hit the coast.
extensive.example_zh: 袭击海岸的风暴造成了大范围破坏。

external.example_en: Paint the external walls before the rainy season starts.
external.example_zh: 在雨季开始前把外墙刷好。

extraordinary.example_en: An extraordinary comet was visible from our balcony last night.
extraordinary.example_zh: 昨晚从我们的阳台能看见一颗非凡的彗星。

extreme.example_en: Extreme cold forced the football match to stop early.
extreme.example_zh: 极端的寒冷迫使足球比赛提前结束。

fair.example_en: The judge gave a fair score to every dancer on the stage.
fair.example_zh: 评委给舞台上的每一位舞者都打了公平的分数。

false.example_en: A false fire alarm emptied the canteen during lunch.
false.example_zh: 一次假火警让食堂在午饭时被清空了。

famous.example_en: The famous swimmer visited our pool and signed our shirts.
famous.example_zh: 那位著名的游泳运动员来到我们的泳池，并在我们的衬衫上签名。

fantastic.example_en: That fantastic save kept our team in the match until the end.
fantastic.example_zh: 那次精彩的扑救让我们队一直撑到了比赛结束。

fascinating.example_en: The fascinating documentary followed turtles across the ocean.
fascinating.example_zh: 那部迷人的纪录片跟随海龟穿越了海洋。

fast.example_en: A fast current pulled the little boat away from the bank.
fast.example_zh: 快速的水流把小船从岸边冲走了。

fat.example_en: The fat sparrow could barely reach the bird feeder.
fat.example_zh: 那只胖麻雀几乎飞不到喂鸟器上。

fellow.example_en: She lent a tissue to her fellow passenger on the crowded train.
fellow.example_zh: 她在拥挤的火车上把纸巾借给了同行的乘客。

female.example_en: A female referee controlled the final with a firm whistle.
female.example_zh: 一位女裁判用有力的哨声掌控了决赛。

filthy.example_en: Filthy mud covered our socks after the cross-country run.
filthy.example_zh: 越野跑之后，污浊的泥巴糊满了我们的袜子。

final.example_en: The final whistle brought a huge cheer from the stands.
final.example_zh: 终场哨声引来看台上巨大的欢呼。

financial.example_en: Dad reads the financial page while he drinks his morning tea.
financial.example_zh: 爸爸早上喝茶时会读报纸的金融版。

fine.example_en: The weather stayed fine, so our picnic blankets remained outside.
fine.example_zh: 天气一直很好，所以我们的野餐垫就留在外面。

flat.example_en: The flat field behind the school is perfect for flying kites.
flat.example_zh: 学校后面那块平地非常适合放风筝。

foreign.example_en: Foreign stamps fill the album my uncle gave me last year.
foreign.example_zh: 外国邮票贴满了叔叔去年送我的集邮册。

formal.example_en: He wore a formal suit to his sister's graduation dinner.
formal.example_zh: 他穿了一套正式西装去参加姐姐的毕业晚宴。

former.example_en: Our former captain spoke to the squad before kickoff.
former.example_zh: 我们的前任队长在开球前对队员讲了话。

free.example_en: I was free after the club, so I helped tidy the art room.
free.example_zh: 社团活动结束后我有空，就帮忙收拾了美术教室。

freezing.example_en: Freezing rain made the playground too slippery for ball games.
freezing.example_zh: 冻雨让操场太滑，没法进行球类游戏。

French.example_en: We bought French bread and cheese for the class picnic.
French.example_zh: 我们为班级野餐买了法式面包和奶酪。

fresh.example_en: Fresh strawberries were cheaper at the morning market.
fresh.example_zh: 新鲜草莓在早市上更便宜。

friendly.example_en: A friendly librarian showed me where the atlases are kept.
friendly.example_zh: 一位友好的图书管理员告诉我地图册放在哪里。

full.example_en: The full kettle was too heavy for my little cousin to lift.
full.example_zh: 满满的水壶太重，我的小表弟提不起来。

funny.example_en: His funny drawing of the head teacher made everyone laugh.
funny.example_zh: 他把校长画得很滑稽，大家都笑了。

general.example_en: The general rule is to walk, not run, inside the corridors.
general.example_zh: 总的规则是在走廊里走路，不要跑。

genuine.example_en: Her genuine apology made her friend forgive the broken vase.
genuine.example_zh: 她真诚的道歉让朋友原谅了打碎花瓶的事。

German.example_en: Our German exchange student shared homemade cake at lunch.
German.example_zh: 我们的德国交换生午饭时分享了自制蛋糕。

glad.example_en: I am glad the lost cat found its way back home.
glad.example_zh: 我很高兴那只走失的猫自己找到了回家的路。

global.example_en: Global news about the flood stayed on television all evening.
global.example_zh: 关于洪水的全球新闻在电视上播了一整个晚上。

grand.example_en: A grand parade filled the main street on National Day.
grand.example_zh: 国庆节那天，隆重的游行挤满了主街。

grateful.example_en: We were grateful when a stranger returned my brother's phone.
grateful.example_zh: 一位陌生人送回了我弟弟的手机，我们非常感激。

great.example_en: A great chance came when the coach needed another singer.
great.example_zh: 教练还需要一名歌手时，一个极好的机会来了。

Greek.example_en: Greek salad was the most popular dish at the food fair.
Greek.example_zh: 希腊沙拉是美食节上最受欢迎的菜。

green.example_en: Green apples from our garden taste sharper than the red ones.
green.example_zh: 我们花园里的青苹果比红苹果味道更酸。

grey.example_en: Grey clouds piled up, so we carried the washing inside.
grey.example_zh: 灰云堆了起来，于是我们把洗好的衣服收了进去。

happy.example_en: Happy shouts came from the playground as soon as the bell rang.
happy.example_zh: 铃声一响，操场上就传来开心的喊声。

hard.example_en: The hard ground made our feet ache during the morning drill.
hard.example_zh: 坚硬的地面让我们在早操时脚发疼。
